**Tier G** — governance — identity, capability, delegation, audit · owned by `platform` · `public.docs_faq`

**One row is** One question and its prepared answer, shown on the manual's Questions & answers page. Authored by super admins from /admin/docs; readers only read.

| Columns | Source | Constraint |

| `question` | UNIQUE constraint | `docs_faq_question_key` |
| `id` | column PRIMARY KEY | `docs_faq_pkey` |

## Governance

| | |
|---|---|
| Read capability | any project member |
| Write capability | `super_admin` |
| Minimum project role | `viewer` |
| Tier transitions audited | **no** — invariant `audit-actor` is not met here yet |
| Row-level security | enabled |
| Policies on the table | **none** |

RLS on and NO policy, deliberately: an unpublished answer, or one about a section the reader may not open, must not be one PostgREST query away. Readers go through `docs_list_faq(p_user_id)`, which applies the Q&A section's audience AND the audience of the section each answer is about; super admins through `admin_list_docs_faq`. Writes are `admin_save_docs_faq` / `admin_delete_docs_faq`, each writing an `admin_audit_logs` row. The reader id is client-asserted (§4 D28), so the filter is as strong as this application's sign-in. An answer should LINK to the page that owns a fact rather than restate it (PLAN.md §6.1 rule 2) — `check:docs` cannot see database content.

> **RLS is on and this table has no policy.** That is deny-all for every role except
> `service_role`, which bypasses RLS. If a page reads this table directly and gets zero
> rows, this is why.

## Columns

`CSV header` is the name the **user types**, which is not always the column name —
that gap is defect D21. A dash means the column has no CSV origin.

| Column | CSV header | Type | Unit | Required in CSV | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` 🔑 | — | `uuid` | — | — | Surrogate id, `gen_random_uuid()`. |
| `question` | — | `text` | — | — | The question as a reader would ask it. Non-blank, and unique — the natural key, which also lets the seed re-run without duplicating. |
| `answer` | — | `text` | — | — | The prepared answer, as Markdown rendered with raw HTML disabled. Links into the manual are written `/docs/<slug>`. |
| `section_key` | — | `text` | — | — | The manual section the question is about, by registry section key, or NULL for a general question. That section's audience applies on top of the Q&A section's own, so an answer about a confidential section stays confidential. |
| `related_slugs` | — | `text[]` | — | — | Manual pages the answer points readers to, by slug. Presentation only; an unknown slug is ignored by the reader page. |
| `sort_order` | — | `integer` | — | — | Display order within the list. Presentation only. |
| `is_published` | — | `boolean` | — | — | Whether readers may see it at all. A draft is listed only to super admins. |
| `created_at` | — | `timestamp with time zone` | — | — | When the entry was created. Server-stamped. |
| `updated_at` | — | `timestamp with time zone` | — | — | When the entry last changed. Server-stamped by the writer. |
| `created_by` | — | `uuid` | — | — | The super admin who created it; NULL for the seeded answers. |
| `updated_by` | — | `uuid` | — | — | The super admin who last changed it; NULL for the seeded answers. |
